title: No Intruder, no Validity: Evaluation Criteria for Privacy-Preserving Text Anonymization
reasoning: The paper's focus is on proposing a technical evaluation framework (TILD) for text anonymization systems to measure their effectiveness in protecting privacy. While data privacy is a significant ethical issue, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark ethics, morals, or faith systems themselves. It evaluates a technical process designed to uphold one specific ethical principle (privacy).
